ph.quote: Cheese made with milk HIU-treated for a long time (10 min) had lower pH values (6.37) than cheese made with milk sonicated for short time (5 min). When using short HIU times, the cheese had a pH of 6.74; this value was closer to the fresh raw milk cheese. The controls had a pH of 6.6

ammonia.reason: No ammonia from amino acid deamination or deamidation due to zero aging and minimal proteolysis.

animal_barnyard.reason: No p-cresol/indole/skatole as pasteurized clean milk without Brevibacterium washed-rind activity.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides due to short 45-min rennet set and no aged proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone methyl ketones from fatty acid beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: High moisture and intact calcium-phosphate casein limit Maillard, only slight surface color when fried.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl/acetoin from minimal citrate fermentation due to direct rennet set with no starter ripening.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very low C4-C8 free fatty acids from negligible lipolysis without mold lipases or aging.

creaminess.reason: Moderate 17.3% fat in 54% moisture matrix gives soft creamy mouthfeel without aged fat proteolysis.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive 1-cm cut rennet curd lightly basket-pressed, not dried-aged, so low fracture crumbliness.

firmness.reason: Basket-molded rennet gel with calcium-retained para-casein gives sliceable firm body at 54% moisture.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol only, no extended phenylalanine catabolism by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Negligible ethyl butanoate/hexanoate due to no ethanol fermentation or esterase activity in fresh curd.

goaty.reason: Low caproic/caprylic/capric acids because cow milk triglycerides lack high short-chain goat fat character.

malty_nutty.reason: Absent Strecker aldehydes like 3-methylbutanal due to no proteolysis-driven leucine/isoleucine catabolism.

melt.reason: Calcium-crosslinked para-casein at pH 6.6 resists flow, softens only when heated, classic non-melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation as no Geotrichum or white-mold surface flora.

oil_off.reason: Fat entrapped in non-melting rennet network with minimal free oil release on heating due to no melt.

smoky.reason: No guaiacol/volatile phenols because curd is uncooked, unstretched and never wood-smoke exposed.

sour_vinegar.reason: Minimal lactic/acetic acid accumulation due to high pH 6.6 and no acid culture development.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading at pH 5.2, so no aligned demineralized casein fibers for stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Slight sulfhydryl/H2S note from pasteurization at 72C for 15s denaturing whey proteins.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose around 2.2% and fresh milk flavor perceived sweet without acid or bitter masking.

umami.reason: Very low free glutamate from casein due to minimal rennet proteolysis at 0 months aging.
